# TruckWys

> TruckWys is load-to-cash software for South African transporters. It prices each load from its real costs (this month's FIASA diesel, the SANRAL mainline toll plazas on the route at the truck's class, border fees, driver allowance and your own rate), raises the invoice with 15% VAT when the load is delivered, shows who owes you by age with reminders sent per invoice after a preview, and reports profit, margin by lane and VAT. It works next to a transport management system (TMS); it does not dispatch, route or schedule. Pricing is R 4 499 per month, plus 0,25% of each delivered load's invoice value (incl. VAT), with unlimited users. Month to month, no long-term contract. Fast Pay and Insurance are coming soon and are not live.

## Key facts

- One plan: R 4 499 per month plus 0,25% of each delivered load's invoice value (incl. VAT). Unlimited loads, quotes, invoices and users. No setup fees. Nothing charged on quotes you lose. No VAT: TruckWys is not registered for VAT, so there is no VAT on the subscription or the fee. Month to month. Cancel with 30 days' written notice.
- Diesel price from FIASA, inland or coastal.
- Tolls: 31 SANRAL mainline toll plazas on the N1, N2, N3, N4, N17 and R30, by vehicle class, from the tariffs effective 1 March 2026 (GG 54087, GG 54088). Tolls go into the quote excl. VAT because a VAT vendor claims the input VAT back.
- Cross-border: border, permit and foreign toll fees for SADC loads, including Botswana, Namibia, Lesotho, Eswatini and Mozambique.
- A warning in rand when a quote is below cost.
- Invoice raised when a load is marked delivered, in TruckWys or from a TMS by API, with 15% VAT, your bank details and the invoice number as the EFT reference. Proof of delivery stays with the load.
- Debtors by age, a statement per customer, and templated reminders that get firmer as days pass, sent by the user from each overdue invoice, in one click after a preview. Not sent automatically and not written by a model.
- Nine reports reconciled to invoices, payments and expenses: profit and loss, sales by month, cash movement, debtors age, customer statement, revenue by customer, revenue by lane, expense report and VAT report. CSV export.
- Copilot: ask about cash, quotes or fleet in plain words. It uses a language model, answers from the company's own data, and drafts quotes and customers for the user to confirm. Prices, tolls, VAT and reminders are rules, not a model.
- Integrations: Cartrack (connect with your Cartrack API username and password, from Fleetweb under Settings, API Settings) and CtrlFleet, API keys and signed webhooks, Excel and CSV import. Xero is coming soon.
- Six user roles: Admin, Manager, Operator, Dispatcher, Viewer, Driver.
- iPhone app on the South African App Store. Android is coming soon.
- Try it: the demo company is open to everyone at https://app.truckwys.com/login (press "View demo"). No sign-up, no call.
- Company: TruckWys (Pty) Ltd, registration 2025/773091/07, 12 Keurboom Road, Claremont, Cape Town, 7800.

## How a load moves through TruckWys

1. Quote from real costs. Pick the customer, vehicle, collection and delivery. TruckWys prices fuel from this month's FIASA diesel, adds the tolls on the route from the 31 SANRAL mainline plazas it carries, at the truck's class (excl. VAT), border fees for SADC loads, driver allowance at your rates and your base rate per kilometre. A warning in rand shows when a quote is below cost. Customers can accept a quote from a link.
2. Delivered means invoiced. Mark the load delivered in TruckWys, or let your TMS do it through the API or a signed webhook, and the invoice is raised with 15% VAT, your terms, your bank details and the invoice number as the EFT reference.
3. See who owes you. Debtors by age, a statement per customer, a formula-based payment score per customer (not a model), and templated reminders that get firmer as the days pass, sent by you from any overdue invoice, in one click after a preview.
4. Know what every lane makes. Profit and loss, net margin by month, revenue per kilometre by lane, revenue by customer and truck, and a VAT report, with CSV for your accountant.

## Where a model is used

- Reading a typed load description to fill the quote form (language model).
- Copilot, which answers from your own data and drafts records you confirm (language model).
- Win probability, from a trained model once about 40 quote outcomes with both wins and losses exist. Before that it says it is still learning.
- Not a model: tolls, diesel, VAT, the below-cost warning, reminders and the payment score.

## FAQ

Q: Is TruckWys a TMS?
A: No. It does not dispatch, route or schedule. It works next to your TMS, your spreadsheets and your tracking, and handles the money on each load.

Q: What does it cost?
A: R 4 499 per month, plus 0,25% of each delivered load's invoice value (incl. VAT). Unlimited users. Month to month. Cancel with 30 days' written notice.

Q: Do you charge VAT?
A: TruckWys isn't registered for VAT yet, so there's no VAT on the subscription or the fee. If that changes, we'll tell you in writing before it applies.

Q: Is there a free trial?
A: No. The demo is open to everyone, with a working company in it. Use it as long as you like before you pay.

Q: Where do diesel and toll prices come from?
A: Diesel from FIASA, inland or coastal. Tolls from the SANRAL tariffs effective 1 March 2026, for 31 mainline plazas, by vehicle class.

Q: Does it work with Cartrack?
A: Yes. Connect with your Cartrack API username and password (in Fleetweb under Settings, API Settings), not your normal login, and vehicle location, speed and ignition status flow in. CtrlFleet connects too.

Q: Can I pay by EFT?
A: The subscription is paid by card through Paystack. Your customers pay you by EFT, straight into your own account.

Q: What about Fast Pay?
A: Coming soon. It is not live, and no rates will be published until it is.

Q: Is there an Android app?
A: Not yet. The iPhone app is on the App Store; the web app works on any phone.
